metaDescription: Meet Kristen Aing, a revenue and GTM leader connecting enterprise cybersecurity, customer insight, clear messaging, and practical learning resources.
headline: Strategist. Leader. Builder.
lead: I'm Kristen Aing, a revenue and GTM leader working in enterprise cybersecurity. I connect customer insight, clear messaging, and hands-on selling to help people make informed decisions about complex technology.

My background in advertising shapes how I think about audiences and stories. I develop practical resources, coach newer sellers, and build independent tools and learning experiences. I want to help people see what's possible and give them the clarity, confidence, and tools to move forward.

principles.name: People first
principles.body: I listen to understand what someone needs, what matters to them, and what would help them move forward.

principles.name: Problem-driven
principles.body: I start with a question or point of friction, then test assumptions before choosing a message, resource, or solution.

principles.name: Systems-minded
principles.body: I turn useful knowledge into resources and workflows that others can find, apply, and improve.

leadershipApproach: I pair clear expectations with thoughtful feedback and room for people to develop their own strengths.
approachIntro: Enterprise selling sits at the center. Content marketing is part of how I support that work: turning buyer questions and field insight into clear messaging, practical playbooks, and learning resources. I also bring that feedback to product and marketing.
careerIntro: The roles and experiences that shaped how I sell, lead, and build.
education: B.S. Advertising, Business Foundations. The University of Texas at Austin.
MBA, IT Management. Western Governors University, in progress.
